The whisper.cpp project distributes the preconverted GGML ftype 1
(mixed F16/F32) file. The historical conversion command and environment
are unknown. This project uses the publisher's converted bytes verbatim.
https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/tree/5359861c739e955e79d9a303bcbc70fb988958b1

Software FP16 conversion follows Maratyszcza/FP16. See FP16-MIT.txt.
YaRN rotary scaling adaptation. See YARN-MIT.txt.
The baseline Arm NEON vector exponential uses Arm Optimized Routines
polynomial constants under the MIT option. See ARM-EXP-COPYRIGHT.txt and
ARM-OPTIMIZED-ROUTINES-LICENSE.txt.
Silero VAD segmentation heuristic. See SILERO-MIT.txt. No Silero weights.
Upstream cites PyTorch SpectralOps for a frame-count formula.
